title: 2021 fitting: selected saved evidence
scope: Selected model parameters, counts and diagnostics copied from the preserved 2021 fitting records. No fitting, prediction or scientific experiment was rerun. Full original fit-row lists remain in the separate research archive.

combined_run_interpretation: The historical run fitted all four 2021 candidates and then assessed 2022 gates. Its revision_required state records the later eligibility problem, not a failure to fit the 2021 candidates.

source_references.dissertation: Integrated dissertation v4, Section 3.4 and Appendix A2

limitations: These fitting residuals were measured on the data used to fit the models.
Successful fitting and full rank do not establish 2022 eligibility or sensor health.
Background is assumed normal and station-history coverage is incomplete.
Temporal dependence and predictions outside humidity bounds were retained in the diagnostics; observations and predictions were not clipped.
